name: Phuket Airport to Koh Lanta

seo.title: Phuket Airport to Koh Lanta Minivan Taxi | VIP Taxi Lanta
seo.metaDescription: Private minivan taxi between Phuket Airport (HKT) and Koh Lanta, both directions, hotel to hotel, one vehicle. Cash to the driver. Price on WhatsApp.

h1: Phuket Airport to Koh Lanta, private transfer
lead: A private minivan between Phuket Airport (HKT) and your hotel on Koh Lanta, in either direction, with no change of vehicle.

facts.label: Drive time
facts.value: About 4 to 5 hours, depending on traffic

facts.label: Pickup and drop-off
facts.value: Phuket Airport (HKT), Your hotel on Koh Lanta

facts.label: Vehicle change
facts.value: None, one vehicle from the airport to your hotel

faq.q: Is it one vehicle all the way from Phuket Airport?
faq.a: Yes. A private minivan from the airport to your hotel on Koh Lanta, no change of vehicle.

faq.q: Can we stop on the way?
faq.a: Tell the driver. It is your vehicle for the trip.

photos.alt: Minivan interior with diamond-stitched tan leather seats and a lit ceiling
photos.shot: Real photo of the VIP Taxi Lanta minivan, shared by every route page today: one photo per route later if possible.
Where the driver meets you at Phuket Airport (arrivals exit, sign with the client's name), no faces needed.

legacyText.title: Phuket Airport to Koh Lanta Minivan Taxi | VIP Taxi Lanta
body: You travel in one vehicle from Phuket Airport to your hotel door on Koh Lanta, with stops when you want them. Send your flight time, your hotel and the number of people, and the team replies with the price.
The same transfer runs from Koh Lanta to Phuket Airport for your departure.
